text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy shows off some<n>astonishing speed
in the Teio Sho,<n>once again leaving the stands
abuzz<n>with excitement!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: W-wow! That gave me chills!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy was so amazing! Just how<n>much stronger
can she get?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
What did I tell you?! She ran like<n>some kind of
beast! It was wild!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Tell me about it! She's something<n>else!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh heh heh... They're all spooked.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Which means... I'm gettin' closer to<n>my ambition!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And since I'm in a good mood, I think<n>I'll give 'em
a holler!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Raaawwwrrr! GRAAAWWWRRR!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Windy?! Eeek! She's so<n>stunning!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
I've... been watching you all this time!<n>I've seen
how you kept on pushing<n>forward!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to keep this momentum shift<n>going so that
everyone all over Japan<n>recognizes her strength!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, this news article Biko showed<n>me isn't too
bad either!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy appears pleased as<n>she looks
through the article that Biko<n>Pegasus told her about.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"A beast of the dirt! Bloodcurdling<n>acceleration!
Otherworldly focus!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And it also says, "Once this terrifying<n>Umamusume
sinks her teeth into you,<n>you'll be hooked on her
brilliant<n>running"!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
People are finally startin' to fear the<n>name Wicked
Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh-heeeh! ♪ Keep the praise<n>comin'!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Lackey! Pick me a race where I can<n>show how
terrifying I really am!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Champions Cup is a G1 race<n>held in winter. It
draws a huge crowd,<n>so a win there will be sure to
create<n>even more buzz.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Great showings in the February<n>Stakes and Teio
Sho have already<n>marked the start and middle of
her<n>senior year, so now it's time to cap it<n>off with a
third G1!
choice_data_list: Make them tremble in awe of your strength!
Make them tremble in awe of your strength!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You bet! Let's go with that plan!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
After I crush the competition with my<n>victory,
everyone will cower in fear!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be so great that no one'll<n>be able to take
their eyes off of me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, our next objective is the<n>Champions Cup.
We'll need to train<n>hard before winter arrives to
ensure<n>our victory.
